tasks.name: Research SQL Standards
tasks.description: Find relevant information about SQL standards
tasks.prompt: Search for SQL standards, including SQL-86, SQL-89, SQL-92, SQL:1999, SQL:2003, SQL:2006, SQL:2008, SQL:2011, SQL:2016, and SQL:2019. Gather information about the key features and changes in each standard.

tasks.name: Organize SQL Standards Information
tasks.description: Organize the gathered information into a structured format
tasks.prompt: Take the gathered information and organize it into a structured format, including an introduction, history of SQL standards, key features of each standard, and a conclusion.

tasks.name: Write SQL Standards Book
tasks.description: Write the book about SQL standards
tasks.prompt: Using the organized information, write a comprehensive book about SQL standards, including examples, use cases, and best practices.

tasks.name: Review and Edit SQL Standards Book
tasks.description: Review and edit the written book
tasks.prompt: Review the written book for grammar, punctuation, and consistency. Edit the book to ensure it is error-free and easy to read.
